candidates.title: RS.HumansOutside null list entry
candidates.finding: A list lookup can return null before the engine reads object field +0x5BC; the existing predicate-failure path continues at RVA 0x002EFEFC.
candidates.nextStep: Design a null guard that reaches the existing next-entry path while preserving the loop's registers and flags.

candidates.title: World/UI missing text subobject
candidates.finding: The +0x5C subobject can be null while its +0x1F0 string is copied into a UI control.
candidates.nextStep: Design and offline-test a trampoline that supplies an empty Delphi string without skipping later parent-object UI updates.

candidates.title: AI cleanup missing list head
candidates.finding: AI cleanup dereferences a global list head before comparing its +0x20 state; the existing less-than-state branch skips to car cleanup at RVA 0x0042AE5D.
candidates.nextStep: Resolve the global owner's lifecycle and verify that a null head may safely use the existing car-cleanup continuation.
